elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Clause 31(a) requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Clause 31(a) requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Clause 31(b) requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Clause 31(c) unconditionally requires USD 5,000,000 in cyber liability coverage for Client Content and other Client or customer data processed, hosted, or transmitted by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: Clause 31(d) requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Clause 31 requires TrueLink to provide Client with certificates evidencing coverage upon request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability (errors and omissions) coverage exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback threshold.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 5,000,000 cyber liability coverage exceeds the USD 2,000,000 fallback threshold and covers Client and customer data.
